name: Mezu
title: Horse-Face
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Mezu and Gozu—or Horse-Face and Ox-Head—are guardians of Izumo’s underworld, Yomi. They once performed identical duties, working together, but the Shattering changed things. Leaving Gozu behind as guard, Mezu frequently travels out into Izumo to guide deceased souls to Yomi if they are lost—or, if they are trying to escape their fate, to subdue them and drag them back.
